course.name: Interfaces and Pages
course.description: Build a page with live data, clear states and a working action.
course.longDescription: 35 minutes required. Prerequisite: Events. Build one small queue page and connect its Refresh action. Optional classes add 10 minutes for reusable widgets, 8 minutes for chat styling and 15 minutes for a human approval prototype. Use a scratch app; the exercises do not send messages or change business records.
